title: Pure Ancient Fairy Dragon
summary: The 2025 Ancient Fairy Dragon archetype with generic staples. This is the page's pure build, not the generic Field Spell engine other decks use. Regulus the Fairy Beast searches World of Spirits, which searches Spore the Fairy Seed. Regulus summons Spore, which gains Levels as it arrives, and the two make Ancient Fairy Dragon. Spore comes back from the GY to turn it into Ancient Fairy Life Dragon, which searches Eternal Sunshine while World of Spirits is up. On the opponent's turn, World of Spirits turns their Special Summons to Defense Position and destroys their Attack Position monsters in the End Phase, and Eternal Sunshine halves and negates a monster once for each Ancient Fairy monster you control. Kuribon the Fairy Spirit is the extra Tuner and shields your Ancient Fairy monsters from destruction.
main: Starter: searches a Spell/Trap that mentions Ancient Fairy Dragon; summons a LIGHT Beast, Plant or Fairy.
Tuner: gains Levels as it is summoned; revives itself from the GY.
Summons itself as a Tuner; returns to the hand to save an Ancient Fairy monster.
Field Spell: searches an Ancient Fairy monster; turns summons to Defense and wipes Attack Position monsters.
Continuous Trap: halves and negates a monster once per Ancient Fairy monster you control.
extra: Level 7: summons from the hand and swaps the Field Spell for another.
Level 8 boss: searches Eternal Sunshine or a LIGHT monster with World of Spirits up; attacks with its DEF.
